message.content: Based on the conversations documented in the sources, there isn't a clear sequence of events indicating that Li Hua thanked Jennifer for the new training schedule before requesting a change for Thursday. In the recorded interactions, Li Hua initially requested a change from Thursday to Friday, stating "Hey Jennifer! Sorry for the last-minute change, but I have an unexpected work meeting tomorrow. Can we reschedule our training session to Friday instead?" (Source 3). Later, in another interaction, Jennifer suggested switching Li Hua's class from Thursday to Friday, and Li Hua accepted the proposal saying, "Awesome! How about the same time, 10:00 am? Looking forward to it!" (Source 6). Therefore, there is no direct mention of Li Hua expressing gratitude for the new training schedule before making his request for a change.
